Sasha R: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's DB failover. Need runbook edits and owners assigned. TL;DR: two recurring patterns found — (1) failover detection lag, (2) stale healthcheck config. Proposing changes to triage steps and escalation path. Can folks pick owners?

Daniel K: I'll take detection lag. Will propose a metric + alert tweak and a small runbook snippet.

Priya M: I'll own healthcheck config and add a playbook entry for a controlled rolling restart.

Mina C: Can we add a compact triage command list (0-10m) so oncall doesn't have to hunt? I'll draft it.

Sasha R: Yes — add it under runbook > "Initial triage (0-10m)". Commands should include quick checks, where to look in logs, and an "if X then escalate" line.

Mina C: Suggested snippet:
```
# quick triage
kubectl get pods -n inference
kubectl logs -l app=inference --tail 200
curl -sSf https://health.example.com/instances | jq .status
# check webhook queue
redis-cli -n 2 llen webhook_queue
```
Look for: repeated connect timeouts, >50% pod restarts in last 10m, or webhook_queue > 1000.

Daniel K: For detection lag: propose synthetic probe + lower detector window 5m->2m. Add 'check alert-webhook queue' step and restart webhook-processor if queue > 500:
```
systemctl status webhook-processor
journalctl -u webhook-processor -n 200
systemctl restart webhook-processor
```
I'll open a PR with metrics and Grafana alerts.

Priya M: Escalation path to add in runbook:
- Pager oncall (primary)
- If no ack in 5m -> @eng-sre oncall
- If severity >= P1 or incidents repeating 3x in 24h -> platform lead (contact info + phone)
Also include Slack quick-dial snippets: `/call eng-sre` etc.

ops-bot: Incident tracker updated: https://tracker.internal/ISSUE-834 — assigned to Sasha R

Sasha R: Owners & timelines agreed:
- Detection lag (Daniel K) — PR + alert by 2024-06-20
- Healthcheck & rolling restart doc (Priya M) — by 2024-06-22
- Runbook triage snippet & edits (Mina C) — PR by 2024-06-18
I'll schedule a 30m follow-up sync 2024-06-24 10:00 PT to verify closures.

Mina C: ack :+1:

Daniel K: ack — I'll add the synthetic probe and run a load test.

Priya M: ack — will add the escalation call steps and test them in staging.

Sasha R: Also adding a recurring item: monthly chaos test for failover detection to catch regressions early.

Daniel K: I'll add the test into CI and link results to the runbook.

Priya M: Linking postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2024-06-db-failover

Mina C: PR opened: https://git.internal/runbooks/pull/492 — includes triage commands and escalation snippet.

Sasha R: Great work. I'll update the postmortem with these action items and mark owners in the tracker. :thumbsup:

Daniel K: Ping me when you want review.

Mina C: Closing thread here unless someone needs more time.

Priya M: Closing from my side too.

Sasha R: Thanks all — closing.
